description: Slide switch, SPDT, miniature, side actuated (right angle at the board edge), SMD, 8 x 2.8 x 1.4 mm, 12 V 50 mA: pins A, COM, B and four shell legs — the tiny power switch of hobby boards

datasheet.revision: Shouhan MSK12C02 specification for approval, version A/0, 2024-12-14: assembly drawing with the recommended mounting pattern (p. 1), ratings (p. 3)

package.name: MSK12C02 (7-pin SMD slide switch)

landPattern.page: p. 1, recommended mounting pattern (安装参考图): two holes dia. 0.85, 3 apart on the centre line; four shell lands 1.05 x 0.7, 8.4 over and 6.3 between them, 2.2 apart (centres); three contact lands 0.6 x 1.3 reaching 2.6 from the hole line, at -2.25, -0.75 (0.75 left of centre, 1.5 apart) and +2.25 (3 right of the middle one): 3, 2, 1 from left as the top view numbers them. Origin at the middle between the holes

package.page: p. 1: body 8 +-0.2 x 2.8 +-0.1, 1.4 +-0.1 high; the actuator 1.3 wide out of the side opposite the contacts, travel 1.6; locating pegs dia. 0.75

pins.name: A
pins.description: throw A (the drawing's 1): joined to COM in one slider position

pins.name: B
pins.description: throw B (3): joined to COM in the other slider position

pins.name: SHELL
pins.description: the metal cover's four legs (4, grounded in the drawing's circuit): to GND or unconnected

notes: Rated 50 mA: switch a regulator's enable pin or a load switch's control, never the battery's full current (a LiPo through it to the board burns the contacts). E.g. COM to a regulator's EN, A to VBAT (on), B to GND (off).
Put it at the board edge with the actuator side (+Y) on the edge line: the actuator sticks out about 1.45 mm.
The two 0.85 mm holes take the locating pegs: non-plated. Reflow once, 260 °C peak (p. 5).
